name: kiro
label: Kiro
description: Kiro's terminal coding agent (kiro-cli), driven over the Agent Client Protocol

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not signed in. Run: kiro-cli login (or set KIRO_API_KEY for headless machines)

env_config.name: KIRO_AGENT
env_config.description: Kiro agent profile to run (a .kiro/agents/<name>.json in the working directory or ~/.kiro/agents). The profile carries this agent's own prompt, tools and MCP servers. Leave empty for Kiro's default agent.

env_config.name: KIRO_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-4.6 (see `kiro-cli chat --list-models`). Leave empty for Kiro's default (auto).

env_config.name: KIRO_API_KEY
env_config.description: Optional. Kiro API key for machines where `kiro-cli login` is not possible; a signed-in CLI needs none.

tagline: Kiro's agent in your workspace, with its own agent profile, tools and MCP servers.
